prompt: Write a short paragraph about why sparse attention helps long-context language models. Keep it around eighty words. No bullet points.
content: Sparse attention mitigates the quadratic computational complexity of standard self-attention, which becomes prohibitively expensive as context length increases. By selectively focusing only on relevant tokens rather than attending to every previous word, models significantly reduce memory usage and processing time. This efficiency allows long-context language models to handle extensive inputs without overwhelming hardware resources. Consequently, sparse attention enables scalable, real-time inference for tasks requiring vast contextual understanding, making it a critical architectural innovation for next-generation large language models.
